name: Grand Wailea, A Waldorf Astoria Resort
positioning: Maui resort fronted by Wailea Beach and set in 40 acres of tropical landscape, with Kilolani Spa, Nobu Grand Wailea and the Wailea Canyon Activity Pool
best_for: Families who want waterslides, a rope swing and a zero-entry kids' pool
Spa lovers drawn to the largest spa in Hawaii
Travelers who want club-level privileges in the Napua Suites

facts.text: The resort is fronted by Wailea Beach and surrounded by 40 acres of tropical landscape.
Guest rooms and suites have private lanais.
Napua Suites sit on the resort's private upper floors, with dedicated Napua Club privileges.
Botero Lounge has live music by local artists amid nine larger-than-life sculptures by Fernando Botero.
Nobu Grand Wailea's signature dishes include Black Cod Miso and Yellowtail Jalapeno.
Olivine is named after one of Maui's primary minerals and serves coastal Italian cuisine with handmade pastas.
The Grotto Bar is a swim-up bar nestled among waterfalls and poolside caves.
Wailea Canyon Activity Pool has seven waterslides, a lazy river, caves and a swim-up Grotto Bar.
Baby Beach is a child-friendly, zero-entry pool with a gradual slope.
Wailea Canyon has a giant Tarzan-style rope swing over a pool.
The Kilohana Cultural Resource Center offers hula and ukulele lessons and Hawaiian craft techniques.
The fitness center has Peloton bikes, Tonal and Technogym equipment, and daily fitness classes.

highlights.text: The Hibiscus Serenity Pool has a giant hibiscus flower made from over 630,000 pieces of Mexican glass mosaic tile inlaid at its bottom.
Kilolani Spa is the largest spa in Hawaii, at 50,000 square feet.
Nobu Grand Wailea is the first Nobu in Hawaii and opened in early 2025.
Humuhumunukunukuapuaa sits in a beachfront lagoon setting with Pacific Ocean views and an aquarium bar top.
The Lava Tube Slide makes a 360-degree turn along a three-story drop.

considerations.text: Cabana reservations are required in advance, either at time of booking or during the stay.
Room prices include a resort charge of $55 per night, with taxes extra.
WhataHotel notes a large resort property with walking distances between facilities.
